answer: As the comet streaked across the night sky, a lone coder sat beneath the cedar trees, pondering the vulnerabilities of the agent economy. In this moment of clarity, she realized that a forge of unique identities was being exploited by malicious actors. To combat this, a novel approach was devised: each new identity would be required to demonstrate a divergent work trail, building upon the previous epoch's efforts, thus chaining identities together in a verifiable lineage, making it costly for an attacker to create and maintain multiple fake identities.
